enforcement_note: DENY. guard_protected_paths blocks rm, Remove-Item and `git rm` aimed at tier0_guard.protected_paths, which defaults to the configured ledger directory plus plans/archive - exactly the two this rule names, no wider. Reading the ledger is untouched; the prohibition is against deletion. Limits, so `live` is not read as unbypassable: the dispatcher is fail-soft, so an exception in the handler allows the call; the guard only sees Bash and PowerShell tool calls, so a script that unlinks the files itself is invisible to it; and an OS-level guarantee needs the sandbox, not a hook.
rule: Never delete or rewrite the change-history ledger or the plan archive.
ai_action: The ledger and plans/archive/ are the audit trail. Correct an entry by appending, never by editing history away.
